LightningComponentBundle.description: Metadata-driven record detail form for Experience Cloud, powered by Envelope_Field__mdt.

property.name: title
property.label: Title
property.description: Optional heading shown above the record detail sections.

property.name: useRelatedRecord
property.label: Use Related Record
property.description: When enabled, loads schema and values from the record referenced by the lookup field below instead of the page record.

property.name: relatedRecordLookupField
property.label: Related Record Lookup Field
property.description: API name of the lookup field on the page record that points to the record to display (e.g. Service__c). Required when Use Related Record is enabled.

property.name: fieldLayout
property.label: Field Layout
property.description: rows = label left, value right (the contact page's frame). grid = responsive multi-column with the label above its value, which reads better on a page of many short fields.
